Vince is sculpted in his powered blue sports coat, with the WWF logo in red and yellow decal on the upper left side of the coat.
Underneath the sports coat is a black tie and a blue dress shirt with a white collar
grey slacks and brown dress shoes.

The figure comes with the interview stage where he would conduct interviews with many WWE superstars such as Hulk Hogan. Also included are two sets of interchangeable hands (open and open grabbing), and a classic WWF microphone with the old logo in yellow.
His head sculpt features a good likeness to his younger days, with brown hair and nicely done facial details. His chin also has a cleft at the center.

His articulation includes a ball jointed neck, ball hinged shoulders, swivel biceps, hinged elbows, swivel-hinged wrists, swivel waist, ball jointed hips, swivel thighs, double hinged knees, hinged and rocker ankles.
